description: A stereo compressor, expander, hard limiter and ducking device, with a display of the compression curve and meters at four points in the chain

params.text: Sets the attack of the compressor, 1ms to 500ms
Delays the signal by 0 to 500ms, so the compression is worked out from the part of the signal that has not been heard yet
Sets the release of the compressor, 1ms to 500ms
Sets the ratio: from 0.1 to 1 the signal is expanded and from 1 to 20 it is compressed
Rounds the corner of the curve at the threshold, from a sharp corner out to the full width of the compressing side
Sets the level the compressor starts working at, -40dB to 0dB
Scales the signal going into the compressor, -40dB to +20dB
Scales the signal leaving the compressor, -40dB to +20dB
Switches the effect off, passing the input straight through
Hides the meters and the curve and shows the parameter values as numbers
Puts the compressor in hard limiter mode, where everything over the threshold is held at the threshold level
Puts the compressor in ducking mode

inputs.text: The left side of the signal into the compressor
The right side of the signal into the compressor
A trigger switches the effect off and on
A trigger switches the hard limiter on and off
A trigger switches ducking mode on and off
The left side of a signal the compressor measures in place of its own input
The right side of a signal the compressor measures in place of its own input

outputs.text: The left side of the processed signal
The right side of the processed signal

notes: four stereo meters read the chain in turn: the input, the signal after PRE, the processed signal and the signal after POST, each showing RMS and peak and turning red when it clips
the centre display draws the compression curve, redrawn as THRESHOLD, RATIO and KNEE are moved
